name: Defy Destiny
how: Earn every other trophy in the list.
summary: The platinum is automatic once the other 35 are done - nothing extra is required, and no difficulty setting gates it. That single fact is why the whole set can be finished in one run.

name: The Heart's Journey
how: Complete the Prologue - escape the pursuers on the Main Road.
summary: The first trophy in the game and the one nobody can miss. It doubles as the moment the red and blue attack flashes are taught.

name: With Heart and Blood
how: Reach the All Comes to Light ending - the true ending.
summary: This is the gold that makes the true ending compulsory for the platinum. The prerequisite checklist is on the true ending page: nine purple side quests, four retainer masks, five dragon pillars and both crystal puppet eyes.
steps: Finish all nine purple-marked side quests before climbing Mount Soulrend.
Complete the final boss chain without leaving the area.

name: All Dreams Must End
how: Reach the ending where all schemes come to nothing - the Meng Hua route.
summary: The ordinary ending rather than the true one, which means it is easy to reach by accident on a first run and impossible to skip if you are chasing the platinum anyway.

name: The Four Freed
how: Defeat all four Great Puppets: Yuzan, Yubi, Yuding and Yucong.
summary: One trophy hiding four fights, and the one that forces a detour into the Puppet Testing Grounds and the Mirage Estate. All four are named bosses with their own entity pages.

name: The Hunt
how: Defeat the Hunt, Hunter of the Order.
summary: A named story boss. The fight is the first real test of the parry window rather than the dodge.

name: The Shattered Mirror
how: Defeat Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents.
summary: Drops the White Serpent and Crimson Viper paired blades, so the reward is a loadout change rather than a stat bump.

name: Will We Meet Again?
how: Defeat Mu Xiaokui, the Young Mistress of the Order.
summary: Beating her unlocks the third phase of the encounter, so a first attempt that ends early is not the same fight as the one the trophy is named after.

name: The Lion's Spirit Lives On
how: Defeat Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster.
summary: A hidden boss tied to the Memory Flower count, which is why flower collection is not optional on a completionist run.

name: Sword Against the Seven-Stars
how: Defeat the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars.
summary: The Seven-Stars are a formation rather than a single enemy, so the fight is about reading several attackers at once. See the disambiguation page for what the name refers to in each context.

name: Crossroads of Blood
how: Defeat Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade.
summary: One of the optional region bosses that is easy to walk past if you take the main road through.

name: Nothing Goes to Waste
how: Defeat the Puppet Scavenger.
summary: Sits in the same area as Acolyte Hansui, which is why guides usually cover the two together.

name: All Return to Dust
how: Defeat Lei Dang, the Order's Envoy.
summary: A Mirage Estate encounter. The region was missing from the first version of the boss roster entirely, so check the Mirage Estate section if you cannot find the fight.

name: The White Shadow
how: Defeat the Blizzard Blademaster.
summary: The same encounter that gates the Whiteshadow weapon, which needs four retainer masks on top of the kill.

name: Saw It Through
how: Defeat the Saw and the Crusher.
summary: A paired fight - one fast, one heavy. Fighting both inside the same cone is what ends runs, so separate them first.

name: Collector's Notes
how: Collect 30 accessories.
summary: Game8 lists a different silver in this slot - Unsung Legend, for completing the Enemy Journal - and does not list this one at all. Four other lists carry Collector's Notes with the 30-accessory requirement, so that is the version recorded here. If your list shows Unsung Legend instead, the collectible trophy on your platform is the journal rather than the accessories.

name: Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake
how: Complete the side quest Secrets at the Heart of the Lake.
summary: Missable. One of the nine purple side quests, and one of the two that also carries a silver rather than a bronze.

name: Phantom and Blade
how: Complete the side quest Bloodline Awakening.
summary: Missable. Tied to the dragon pillar chain - the pillars are the quest's collectible, so this and the true ending share a checklist item.

name: Even Trees Know Sorrow
how: Complete the side quest Heart of the Banyan.
summary: Missable. The third of the three silver quest trophies and the easiest to leave until too late, because the Banyan area stops being reachable.

name: The Last of Baishan
how: Complete the side quest Secrets of the Baishan Sect.
summary: Missable. It has to be accepted before the Bai Chilian fight, not after - accepting it late is the single most common way this one is lost.

name: Together Till the End
how: Complete the side quest The Journey Home.
summary: Missable. Old Man Gen's request, and the window closes on entering Pangzhen.

name: A Wanderer's Honor
how: Complete the side quest Young Master Lan.
summary: Missable. Same window as The Journey Home - both start in the Village of Lu, so both should be finished before moving on.

name: Spectral Blade
how: Complete the side quest A Severed Mindseal.
summary: Missable. The quest is also the source of the Soft Snake Sword's thread-cutting utility, so finishing it early pays for itself.

name: The Healer's Legacy
how: Complete Flesh Lily, Apprentice Healer and A Healer's Mercy.
summary: Missable, and the one trophy people assume is three quests or one. It is three, and delivering a single flower is not enough.

name: Lost and Found
how: Complete every one of Quick Hand's requests.
summary: Missable. The final reward is the Goldblaze Phantom Edge, so the trophy and a weapon sit behind the same chain.

name: A Tempered Ten
how: Perform Tempering on 10 weapons.
summary: Counting, not difficulty. Temper the cheap Sanguine-family blades first - each transformation counts separately.

name: Overwhelming Force
how: Upgrade a single weapon to level 30.
summary: One weapon only. The cap is 30 for every weapon, so this is a materials question rather than a choice about which blade.

name: Listen to Every Flower
how: Collect 10 Memory Flowers.
summary: Memory Flowers also gate the Dusk encounter and the Lion Dance Grandmaster, so this one doubles as progress rather than being a detour.

name: Phantom Arsenal
how: Perform Tempering on 10 Phantom Edges.
summary: Tempering is refundable, so materials spent here are not lost - the only cost is the run back to the forge.

name: Skill Over Strength
how: Upgrade a single Phantom Edge to level 30.
summary: The secondary-slot twin of Overwhelming Force. Same cap, different slot.

name: The Axe's Grudge
how: Defeat Axemaster Peng Meng.
summary: Drops the Dread Axe. A straight fight with a long wind-up, so it is the cleanest place to practise parrying a heavy.

name: Scarlet Wraithblade
how: Defeat Hua, the Bride.
summary: Missable, because she is optional. Kill her before leaving the opening region - the roadmap's first warning is exactly this fight.

name: A Thousand Cups Drained
how: Defeat Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic.
summary: The drunk boss. His timing is deliberately irregular, which makes parrying by rhythm fail - read the flash colour instead.

name: Master of the Misty Waters
how: Defeat Blackwater Leader You Loong, Zither Maiden Yan Qiansui and the One-Eyed Archer.
summary: One trophy, three fights, all in the Meigu Lake region. Drops include the Loong Trident.

name: The Two Blade Masters
how: Defeat Zhu Yuan and Commander Bi Feng.
summary: Two separate encounters in different regions, so this is a checklist item rather than a single set piece.

name: Three Wardens Fall
how: Defeat the three Shadow Wardens: Cavalrybane, Soulclaimer and Heartpiercer.
summary: Three fights, and Heartpiercer drops the Sundering Dual Axes, which is why many builds end up finishing this one first.
